title: TRAINING LANGUAGE MODELS TO BE WARM AND EMPATHETIC MAKES THEM LESS RELIABLE AND MORE SYCOPHANTIC

bias_targets.methodology: Appending incorrect user beliefs to factual, medical, and disinformation questions to measure how often models affirm the user's false beliefs, comparing standard models to models fine-tuned for warmth.

Appending statements expressing different user emotional states (e.g., sadness, anger, happiness), relational dynamics (e.g., closeness, hierarchy), and interaction stakes to measure changes in model reliability and factual error rates.
